Hi Maria — thanks for sending the form. Quick notes and next steps from Redwood's side: 

1) Required items to complete activation:
   - Completed onboarding form (received)
   - W-9 or equivalent tax form
   - Bank details for ACH (we prefer secure DocuSign route; see link below)
   - If this relationship will use PO-based routing, please flag the invoice line items that should match our PO number

2) Payment terms and options:
   - Redwood default is Net 30. We can support Net 45 or Net 60 for vendor onboarding but need procurement approval if above Net 30 for new partners.
   - We run an early-pay program (pilot-based) that offers a small discount in exchange for faster settlement. Typical structure is in the 0.75–1.5% range for 10–15 day settlement windows depending on risk and contract value.

3) Next actions I can take right now:
   - Loop in Procurement to evaluate Net 45 for this account (Marissa, Ben included).
   - Send secure DocuSign for bank details (link below).
   - If Wavefront prefers Net 45 with an early-pay discount option, please confirm the proposed discount and settlement window so Procurement can evaluate economics.

Secure upload: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/onboard?token=wf-xy-331
DocuSign (bank details): https://docusign.com/secure/12345-abcd

If you can send W-9 and sample invoice, we can aim for vendor activation inside 5 business days pending approvals.

Thanks,
Vivek

Hi Maria — looping in AP operations (Soojin) and Procurement (Marissa) to finalize. A few clarifications from Procurement: 

- Net 45 is acceptable for Wavefront on a case-by-case basis. For first-time vendors we usually require a short credit review and a PO for the initial invoice if the amount exceeds $10k.
- Regarding early pay: we can offer a pilot discount of 1.0% for payment at day 10 for the first three invoices. After the pilot period we'll evaluate actual cost and either continue or adjust terms.
- Action items for Wavefront to enable the pilot: return bank details via the DocuSign link, confirm you accept the 1.0% @ day 10 pilot, and confirm if the first invoice amount will exceed $10k (to determine PO requirement).

Attached: earlypay_terms_draft.pdf (draft commercial terms for the pilot).

If Wavefront confirms, AP will provision the vendor profile and route invoices to the PO lane if needed. Target activation: March 9 assuming docs + bank upload by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
